explication: Frappe CRM is a sales-team CRM built on Frappe, with a Vue interface for managing leads, deals, contacts and their activities. A central workflow is navigating CRM views and working a lead or deal through its details and related activity; the README also highlights Kanban and customizable views. Separate capabilities include website-based domain enrichment, service-level tracking, telephony, WhatsApp and ERPNext integration. The enrichment flow is visible in sampled source; several other links reflect README-described capabilities, since their runtime wiring was not sampled.
